title: objectql: a function's bare-name record follows its holders — a sealed re-bind releases the old owner's claim, and the last remaining holder answers the bare read (ADR-0150 D4; collects #32534 #32639)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CaP1iy4RSEQbW6177G

立卡门 ① · 已落地工作欠的后续：PR #32468（#32349）契约审查 r2 6809277278 的 S1 余项（should-fix）。Part of #31527 (ADR-0150)。Blocked-by #32468.

## What

PR #32468 re-binds a multi-package artifact's hooks and functions per declaring body, and `releaseMovedFunctions` takes a moved function off its still-named old owner. The old owner's **bare-name claim** stays in the registry until `uninstallPackage`. After the cold-boot seal, `claimBareNameFunctions` then throws for the gaining owner, so that owner's group is left unbound; with the release, the moved function is held by nobody.

Reach (as the review states it): the exported binder called twice with callables on a sealed engine; not the JSON install-local door. `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` was outside #32349's surface.

## Acceptance

- A single-claim release in `registry.ts`: when a function moves from owner A to owner B on a re-bind, A's bare-name claim on that one name is released before B claims it, on a sealed engine.
- Pin: re-bind after the seal moves the function, B's group binds, the function is held by B; CONTROL: A's other claims stay.
- `Clause-②:` measure (likely `no`); contract review owed if it narrows.

## 业务理由

谁受益：重装或热更多包制品的部署。场景：制品重绑后某函数换了归属包。不做：新归属包的整组 hook 静默不绑定，该函数无人持有，调用时失败。

## 读者

`domain:server` 席位（专题 #31527 派），#32468 合并后，起点 `registry.ts` 的 bare-name claim 与 `releaseMovedFunctions`。

## 查重

`repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue claimBareNameFunctions release bare-name claim` → 1 hit (#30803, closed); none tracks this release. No duplicate.

## Collecting card (epic seat, #32639 folded in)

Per the maintainer ruling recorded at 6829776521 on #31527 (same-family corner cards fold into one collecting card; first-party exposure 0 on each). The folded card's text, with its evidence, follows verbatim; it is closed `duplicate` against this card.

### Folded from #32639

<details><summary>#32639 as filed</summary>

epic:#31527#1 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CbqzUZJRphdYbBQ16b

Parent: #31700 (ADR-0150 child B; epic #31527, red line 2: ambiguity is reported, never guessed).
Found by: the dev of #31700 (PR #32513, report 6818542238, `out_of_scope_findings`). The seat's contract review 6819064294 measured it at `caf6941d89` (boundary flags) and asked for this card.

## Premise

The engine keeps two function maps: `functions`, the bare map (one entry per name, the last registration), and `functionHolders`, the per-package holder set (ADR-0150 D4, #31716). `ObjectQL#unregisterFunctionsByPackage(P)` (`packages/objectql/src/engine-hooks-and-functions.ts`) deletes the bare entry only when it is P's, and drops P from the holder set. So when two packages hold a name and the one registered LAST leaves, the bare map loses the name while the other package still holds it. `resolveFunctionEntry(NAME)` and `resolveFunction(NAME)` then answer nothing, although the remaining package is now the name's one holder and a one-holder name should resolve to it.

- `main` behaves the same. #31700 makes the state newly reachable: two namespaces' packages may now each bind a function of one name through a package bind. Before, only a direct `ObjectQL#registerFunction` under two package owners reached it.
- Re-check: alpha and beta bind `f`, beta last. Call `unregisterFunctionsByPackage` with beta's owner id. `functionHoldersOf('f').packageHolders` still names alpha, and `resolveFunctionEntry('f')` is `undefined`.

## Who reads it

- The readers by package go through `functionHoldersOf` and are not affected: the flow `script` and screen nodes (`AutomationEngine.resolveFunction` → `resolvePackageScopedFunction`) and the hook binder (`functionHoldersOf(name).packageItem(own package)`).
- The one production reader of the bare entry, runtime `releaseMovedFunctions` (#32468), reads it only for a one-holder name since #31700 R3-B. The seat measured that it tolerates the miss.
- So the miss is the bare read itself, by a caller with no package.

## Fix shape (estimate)

- When a holder leaves and exactly one holder of the name remains, the bare read answers that holder's entry: put it back into the bare map, or derive the bare answer from the holder set. An environment (package-less) registration keeps its current rules.
- Pin it: two holders, the last-registered leaves → the bare read answers the remaining holder's entry. CONTROLs: the first-registered leaves (unchanged), two holders remain (409 naming both, unchanged), a one-holder name leaves (nothing, unchanged).
- If a public answer moves, declare it FROM → TO with its Clause-② arm, and check the other bare-map holders the same way (`hook` has no bare read).

## Order

Lands after #31700 (PR #32513), which this builds on. Same lane (epic #31527 seat 1).

Blocked-by: #31700

</details>
